fixture: native-badpurl-1.1.0 (paired against native-sbom-1.1.0, whose component purl parses)
note: The SBOM covers the right library and gives its component the purl `pkg:@2.1.0`, which has no type and cannot parse under the purl grammar. A purl that does not parse cannot join against an advisory, so the component is inventoried and still invisible to every scanner that keys on identity - the SBOM is present, covering, and useless. MIRI-PY-025 is a SHOULD worth 1, and it is the check that stops MIRI-PY-024 from being satisfiable with an inventory nothing can query.

must_report_on.evidence_note: MIRI-PY-025's violation_unit is `each malformed SBOM purl`, so the evidence names the field rather than the document: one violation per purl, and the report has to say which.

must_not_report_on.note: Same document shape with `pkg:generic/libgreet@2.1.0`, which parses.

why_this_case_was_missing: MIRI-PY-025 had no artifact because nothing in the suite shipped an SBOM at all.
